snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Secluded Springs  | Coming August 28!
snippet.description:
Raikou, Entei, and Suicune headline the new expansion, along with a variety of events that will arrive in the game throughout September.

The new Secluded Springs Expansion launches in @PokemonTCGPocket on Wednesday, August 27, 2025, at 11:00 p.m. PDT.

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
Official Site: https://www.pokemon.com
